name: Chicken Salad
steps: Create chili mayo by mixing together mayonnaise, siracha, honey, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Cook the chicken breast in a pan until fully cooked.
Cut the lettuce, cucumber, and leeks into bite-sized pieces.
Mix the lettuce, cucumber, leeks, corn, and cheese in a large bowl.
Add the sliced chicken on top of the salad.
Drizzle chili mayo over the salad and toss to combine.
